source.label: Wizards event coverage, 2005 Vintage Championship (Ted Knutson)

notes.text: Seeds and finishes from the Top 8 bracket in the coverage. The same page also carries non-Top 8 lists (Vroman, Chitturi's Blue-white Fish, Des Jardins, Escribano); the Top 8 lists are those under "Top 8 Decklists".
Date from the Wizards Gen Con Indy 2005 schedule ("Saturday 8/20 10am - Vintage Championship").
Called Andy "Brassman" Probasco in the match text.
The deck header says "Matt Endress"; the bracket says "Mat Endress".
The deck header says "Hale Simon"; the bracket and match text say "Simon Hale".
Wizards' coverage prints "Demars". Written DeMars, as the 2009 coverage spells it, so one person has one name.
